checks: Typing numbers/formulas and Enter commits with correct recalculation
Relative Ctrl+D fill, undo, and redo
Formula bar edit and SUM range evaluation
Pointer double-click starts a cell edit; Escape discards pending input
Pointer double-click and inline worksheet rename
Clipboard-event TSV rectangle paste and relative formula copy/paste
Reference equations, error-producing equations, numeric conversion, and ordinary-text transfer
Add/switch worksheets; cross-sheet references survive tab rename
Explicit worksheet deletion and undo restore its formula data
Distant row edit, Ctrl+Home/End, and viewport-bounded cell DOM
limitations: Clipboard tests dispatch real DOM ClipboardEvents with DataTransfer payloads; operating-system clipboard interoperability was not exercised.
This fixture does not test document/sidebar selection bookmarks, native application menus, filesystem recovery, or the final Windows package.
The measured DOM cell count establishes virtual rendering, not a RAM or typing-latency benchmark.
scope: Isolated SpreadsheetView Electron renderer fixture; production desktop shell and final packaged bundle are not covered.
